name: How long does it take to see results from topic cluster implementation for AEO?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from topic cluster implementation for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for seeing results from topic cluster implementation for AEO can vary significantly, typically ranging from 3 to 6 months. This depends on factors such as the competitiveness of the industry, the current authority of the website, the quality and quantity of content created, and how frequently search engines crawl and re-index your site. Initial improvements in keyword rankings and organic traffic may appear sooner, but substantial AEO benefits, like consistent featured snippet appearances, often require sustained effort and time for search engines to fully recognize the expertise and structure of the clusters.
